title: Shinonome Ena — Distant Summer Festival〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: The Sounds of a Summer Festival!

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Why do I have to go...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, stop being such a baby. I'm not the only one getting pancakes, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: On top of that, you haven't properly thanked me yet for getting your shoes back, so you'll be paying for me.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, yeah...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Also, this place we're going to today is doing its grand opening or something, so we get a discount on toppings if we go as three or more.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh... It's a new store that I probably would've ended up going to anyway, so I'll let this one slide.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, don't give me that look. You weren't exactly my first choice in terms of who to take either, you know?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I was actually hoping to go with Kanade, Airi and Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But Kanade's busy with our next song, and Airi's busy making new videos with her group, so maybe next time.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I was even thinking about inviting Mafuyu, but she's busy with cram school on weekends, so I ran out of options...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That's why you get to treat me for rescuing your shoes.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I know. You don't need to remind me.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, let's try to enjoy ourselves. Especially since delicious pancakes are awaiting us♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But you're really old fashioned about returning favors, huh, Li'l Bro?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If I don't, it'll definitely come back to bite me in the butt.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And you're one to talk. Why'd you decide to come along?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Because I was bored, and I felt bad about how everyone else flaked on Ena.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I also thought it'd be fun since she said that YOU'D be here too, Li'l Bro!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Seriously...?
But I guess it's not like you were dragged out here by her.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Lately, it feels like Ena's been worried and trying to do stuff for me...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, what are you two talking about?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? About you behind your back...

rows.Speaker: Ena & Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Ena? Mizuki...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, Mafuyu!
Are you on your way to cram school?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes. Hm...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hello, Ena, Mizuki.
And... Ena's brother?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Nice to meet you. My name is Mafuyu Asahina. I've been hanging out quite a lot with Ena lately.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Nice to meet you too.
I'm Akito Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Are you from her group too?
I hope things are going well between all of you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yikes... Polite Mafuyu gives off this really weird vibe, you know?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I guess she has to act that way since she's never met Li'l Bro before. We haven't seen her flip that switch in a while, huh?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, I guess you're right...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (After what happened with her, Miku and SEKAI, she's been herself ever since and just spouting whatever comes to mind.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But that probably means it's less stress for her, so I guess that's a good thing...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, maybe we should move off to the side to talk? Someone with a giant dog is coming right this way.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, you're right.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Li'l Bro?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm fine. Don't worry about me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm sorry. We didn't mean to block your path.

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line:
No, I apologize too.
He's just gotten so big...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, a golden retriever.
Hello.

rows.Speaker: Dog
rows.Line: *Sniff*... *Whimper*...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hm?
Oh, I guess he doesn't like being touched.

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line: That's strange. He usually loves meeting other people and wags his tail to show it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I guess animals can pick up on it immediately. It's like they know something's wrong...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. Yeah, I guess so...

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line: If you'll excuse me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, I need to go soon as well.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yup, alright. See you on Nightcord.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, wait...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sorry about that. This is just how she is, so if you'll just understand...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
Now, if you don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Laters.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What do you mean, This is how she is?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: For your information, I've been doing a ton for Mafuyu and tiptoeing around all of her problems.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? What are you talking about?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ugh, you...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay, okay. Relax, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Li'l Bro just doesn't know what Mafuyu's really like.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I know, but...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And we have delicious pancakes waiting for us up ahead, so let's get going♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: True.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And you're not going anywhere, Akito!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I know.
Also, we needed to take a left back there.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Shut up. I knew that...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You liar!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hahaha!
